identity.subject: Venture capital fund launch
identity.proposition: Invest in technologies that expand human limits.

grade.saturationNote: Hold ground saturation at 0%. Push accent saturation to 95%.
grade.lightSourceDescription: Direct a 90-degree spotlight from 50% width, 0% height with 80% radial falloff.

families.usedFor: Set primary statements, body copy, and captions.

setting.opticalNotes: Align text blocks to absolute center. Ignore ascenders and descenders for vertical centering.

anchorsUsed.whatSitsThere: Place primary statements and body copy.

typeInMotion.entrance: Type on characters sequentially or scale from 80% to 100% while fading opacity from 0% to 100%.

moves.whatMotivatesIt: showcase multiple UI elements in 3D space

camera.depthOfFieldNote: shallow depth of field used during the 3D orbit sequence to focus on the central UI elements

easingsUsed.name: ease_in_out_quad
easingsUsed.appliedTo: camera zooms and UI element scaling

motion.idleMotionDescription: subtle fluid-like animations in the background gradients and continuous drawing of the white line
motion.velocityProfile: starts slow, builds to a fast-paced montage in the middle, and ends with a slow, deliberate reveal

transitions.causedByWhatIsAlreadyOnScreen: zooming into the array of UI elements

threeD.whatIsDimensional: the pill-shaped UI elements and the glowing orb
threeD.lightingSetup: single overhead spotlight with a soft falloff, creating a dramatic, high-contrast look
threeD.materials: glass-like material for the UI elements with internal fluid animations, and an emissive material for the glowing orb
threeD.whyItEarnsItsPlace: adds depth and complexity to the visual representation of the technologies being discussed

ui.howProductIsShown: pill-shaped elements containing text and icons, arranged in a 3D array
ui.cropOrFraming: centered, taking up 60% of the frame width
ui.annotationStyle: minimalist sans-serif text, white on dark backgrounds or dark on light backgrounds

editing.rhythmRule: Decrease shot duration to 0.50s during lists, increase to 8.00s for resolutions.

sync.rule: Snap hard cuts to 120 BPM grid transients.
sync.whatHappensOnTheLoudestHit: Flash screen to 100% white for 0.08s, trigger 40Hz sub-boom.

beats.whatChanges: Transitions from 48px monochrome typing to 100% width gradient bands with scaling text.
Shifts to 2px continuous line drawing and 2D vector hands interacting with a 300px gradient orb.
Rapid 1.25s cuts of 800x450px glassmorphism cards over tiled monospace background text.
Introduces 3D extruded pill shapes multiplying along a 45-degree Z-axis, ending in a 100% Y-axis gradient scale.
Fades to #111111 for 1.50s SVG path morph of the logo and 2.00s subtitle typing.

rulesItNeverBreaks: Center all primary text horizontally at 50% of frame width.
Restrict color palette to #FFFFFF text on #111111 backgrounds, using #FF0055 and #0044FF exclusively for gradient accents.
Maintain voiceover pacing at 130 WPM with -14 LUFS integrated loudness.
recipe: Set project resolution to 1920x1080, 30fps. Set base background to #111111.
0.00s-0.02s: Type '{We invest in te}' at 50% frame width, 50% frame height, 48px font size, over 2.00s.
0.02s-0.05s: Flash 3 horizontal bands (100% width, 30% height) with #0044FF to #FF0055 gradients. Scale text 'Faster.', 'Smarter.', 'Stronger.' from 100% to 115% over 1.00s each using ease_out_cubic.
0.05s-0.11s: Draw a continuous 2px #FFFFFF line forming a human profile at 50% width, 50% height over 6.00s. Drop a 300px circular gradient orb from -20% height to 20% height.
0.11s-0.14s: Animate two 400px hand vectors reaching toward the center orb. Apply a 0.20s displacement map glitch effect at 13.00s.
0.14s-0.19s: Tile background with 64px monospace text. Overlay 800x450px glassmorphism cards (20px background blur, 10% opacity white fill) containing 3D renders. Cycle cards every 1.25s.
0.19s-0.22s: Cascade the word 'NOW' vertically down the Y-axis from 20% to 80% height in 0.50s increments.

0.22s-0.27s: Generate 3D pill shapes (400x150px). Extrude 50px. Map #0044FF/#FF0055 gradients. Multiply to 20 instances, align along a 45-degree Z-axis diagonal, and rotate camera -30 degrees on Y-axis.
0.27s-0.31s: Draw a 4px horizontal line at 50% height. Scale Y from 4px to 1080px over 4.00s using ease_in_expo, filling the screen with a #A020F0 to #FFC0CB gradient.
0.31s-0.40s: Fade to #111111. Morph SVG paths to form 'augment.' logo at 50% width, 40% height over 1.50s. Type subtitle at 55% height over 2.00s. Fade in 'www.augment.fund' at 80% height at 38.00s.
Audio: Mix voiceover to -14 LUFS. Add 60 BPM ambient synth bed at -24 LUFS. Layer 0.10s digital glitch SFX at 13.00s and 14.00s at -18 LUFS.
system.whatWouldBeHardestToCopy: The 3D pill cascade (22.00s-27.00s). Weaker studios will fail the depth of field (f/2.8 equivalent blur on background pills) and the precise 45-degree spatial distribution, resulting in a flat 2D array instead of a volumetric 3D tunnel.

events.instruction: Type on '{We invest in technologies that make humans}' at 50% x, 50% y over 1.50s. Hold for 0.70s. Fade opacity to 0% over 0.30s.
events.whyItReads: Establishes core premise at 130 WPM.

events.instruction: Speak 'We invest in technologies that make humans' at 130 WPM. Peak level at -14 LUFS.
events.whyItReads: Delivers primary narrative.

events.instruction: Reveal a horizontal container at 50% y, 100% width, 25% height. Fill with #0033FF gradient. Render 'Faster.' at 50% x, 50% y.
events.whyItReads: Accelerates pacing with 0.60s cuts.

events.instruction: Shift gradient to include #FF0055. Replace text with 'Smarter.' at 50% x, 50% y.
events.whyItReads: Builds visual intensity via color shift.

events.instruction: Shift gradient to include #8800FF. Replace text with 'Stronger.' Expand container height to 100% over 0.95s on ease_out_cubic. Overlay 1px white sine waves.
events.whyItReads: Maximizes visual weight before a hard cut.

events.instruction: Draw a 2px #FFFFFF path starting from 50% x, 100% y. Trace a human profile ending at 50% x, 40% y over 3.50s on linear easing.
events.whyItReads: Connects human element to abstract space.

events.instruction: Tilt camera down 50% over 1.50s on ease_out_cubic to reveal a 30% width spherical gradient orb at 50% x, 20% y.
events.whyItReads: Introduces the technological catalyst.

events.instruction: Translate two #FF0055 hand vectors from 0% x and 100% x to intersect the orb at 50% x over 2.00s. Trigger 1.50s of RGB split and horizontal displacement glitch at 12.00s.
events.whyItReads: Visualizes human-tech synthesis via 15% frame distortion.

events.instruction: Tile 'ROBOTICS' in mono font at 10% height across background. Center a 60% width, 40% height video container at 50% x, 50% y. Overlay 'Robotics.' and a 20% width 1px circle.
events.whyItReads: Establishes 1.00s montage rhythm.

events.instruction: Update background text to 'NEUROTECH'. Update video container content. Update overlay text to 'Neurotech.'
events.whyItReads: Maintains 1.00s montage rhythm.

events.instruction: Update background text to 'DEFENSE'. Update video container content. Update overlay text to 'Defense.'
events.whyItReads: Maintains 1.00s montage rhythm.

events.instruction: Update background text to 'AI AGENTS'. Update video container content. Update overlay text to 'AI agents.'
events.whyItReads: Maintains 1.00s montage rhythm.

events.instruction: Update background text to 'LONGEVITY'. Update video to eye macro. Update text to 'Longevity.' Zoom camera 20% into the video container over 2.50s on linear easing.
events.whyItReads: Breaks the 1.00s rhythm to signal section end.

events.instruction: Display the string 'ISN'T FUTURE TALK' in a repeating grid layout covering 100% of the frame.
events.whyItReads: Establishes the initial textual context before a rapid transition.

events.instruction: Scale the central gradient mask from 40% to 100% of frame width and height.
events.whyItReads: Creates a visual expansion that overtakes the background text.

events.instruction: Replace the repeating grid text with the string 'IT'S HAPPENING'.
events.whyItReads: Accelerates the pacing through rapid copy changes.

events.instruction: Replace the text with the string 'NOW' arranged in a staggered vertical column, offset by 10% of frame width per line.
events.whyItReads: Focuses attention on a single, urgent word before a scene cut.

events.instruction: Fade in a pill-shaped container at 50% width, 50% height. Render the string 'We build.' and a globe vector icon inside. Apply a gradient background to the container.
events.whyItReads: Introduces the core visual motif for the next sequence.

events.instruction: Orbit the camera 180 degrees around the central container while translating backward on the Z-axis to reveal an array of 20 identical containers spaced evenly.
events.whyItReads: Demonstrates scale and multiplicity of the subject matter.

events.instruction: Scale the Y-axis of all containers to 1% of frame height, merging them into a single horizontal line spanning 100% of frame width.
events.whyItReads: Condenses complex 3D geometry into a simple 2D graphic element.

events.instruction: Scale the horizontal line on the Y-axis from 1% to 100% of frame height, filling the screen with the gradient colors.
events.whyItReads: Washes the screen with color to act as a transitional wipe.

events.instruction: Fade the screen opacity from 100% to 0%, revealing a black background.
events.whyItReads: Provides a visual reset before the final logo reveal.

events.instruction: Reveal the string 'augment.' at 50% width, 50% height. Morph the vector paths of the characters from abstract curves to standard neo-grotesque letterforms.
events.whyItReads: Introduces the brand identity with a custom typographic animation.

events.instruction: Render a radial gradient glow behind the 'augment.' text. Shift the hue of the gradient continuously through the accent palette.
events.whyItReads: Adds visual interest and ties the logo back to the film's color system.

events.instruction: Type on the string 'A fund for those who rewrite human capability.' at 50% width, 60% height.
events.whyItReads: Delivers the primary proposition statement clearly.

events.instruction: Type on the string 'www.augment.fund' at 50% width, 90% height.
events.whyItReads: Provides the call to action and destination URL.

events.instruction: Hold the word 'augment.' at 50% of frame width and 45% of frame height. Hold the sentence 'A fund for those who rewrite human capability.' at 50% of frame width and 55% of frame height. Hold the URL 'www.augment.fund' at 50% of frame width and 90% of frame height.
events.whyItReads: Provides time to read the final brand lockup.

events.instruction: Hold the background spotlight at 50% of frame width and 50% of frame height with 80% radial falloff over a #0A0A0A ground.
events.whyItReads: Maintains visual focus on the center text.

events.instruction: Fade the low-frequency synth drone from -24 LUFS to -60 LUFS over 0.98s on a linear curve.
events.whyItReads: Concludes the audio track.

events.instruction: Hold all elements at 0 pixels per second velocity.
events.whyItReads: Creates a static end frame.

events.instruction: Hold camera position at 0% amplitude.
events.whyItReads: Keeps the frame stable.
